exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: DNS
exploitedBy.relevance: DNS is used as the application layer protocol to exfiltrate data through recursive queries across zone boundaries.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Protocol Tunneling
exploitedBy.relevance: DNS recursive queries can be used to tunnel exfiltrated data through protocol encapsulation across network zone boundaries.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Mail Protocols
exploitedBy.relevance: Open SMTP relays across trust zones directly exploit mail protocols to traverse security boundaries.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Email Spoofing
exploitedBy.relevance: Open SMTP relays across trust zones enable email spoofing by allowing unauthenticated message relay.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: DNS/Passive DNS
exploitedBy.relevance: Unrestricted zone transfers expose full DNS zone data, enabling passive DNS reconnaissance across network segments.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: DNS Server
exploitedBy.relevance: Unrestricted zone transfers between segments represent a DNS server misconfiguration that can be exploited to compromise DNS infrastructure.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Network Boundary Bridging
exploitedBy.relevance: Split-horizon DNS misconfigurations allow attackers to bypass ingress filtering by bridging network boundaries through improper DNS view separation.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Fast Flux DNS
exploitedBy.relevance: Split-horizon misconfigurations can be abused similarly to fast flux techniques to obscure malicious infrastructure and bypass ingress controls.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Domain Accounts
exploitedBy.relevance: Service account credentials propagating across zones most commonly involve domain accounts whose privileges extend across network segment boundaries.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Trusted Relationship
exploitedBy.relevance: Cross-zone credential propagation exploits trusted relationships between zones that allow service accounts to authenticate across security boundaries.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Network Sniffing
exploitedBy.relevance: Monitoring gaps on foundational service traffic between zones allow adversaries to sniff network traffic without detection.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Email Forwarding Rule
exploitedBy.relevance: Trust inheritance in email headers across zones can be abused in conjunction with forwarding rules to escalate access or leak sensitive communications.
